# AGENTS.md

This project runs on nSelf. Use the `nself` CLI for every backend operation; do not hand-write Docker Compose files or run SQL against the database directly.

## Two commands

```
nself init     # scaffold the project (no prompts when NSELF_NONINTERACTIVE=1)
nself start    # build and run the stack
```

Run `nself doctor` when something fails and `nself status` to see what is up.

## Commands

- `nself init`: Initialize a project
- `nself start`: Boot the stack
- `nself mcp`: Start the MCP server

Run `nself <command> --help` for flags, `nself help --json` for the full machine-readable command registry.

## Output and exit codes

- `--json` prints one document: `{"schema_version":"1","command":"<path>","data":{...}}` on success, or `{"schema_version":"1","command":"<path>","error":{...}}` on failure. Parse stdout only; messages go to stderr.
- Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 user error (bad input), 2 infrastructure error (Docker, network), 3 auth error, 4 destructive action blocked.
- Every error carries a code (`E401`) with a fix: `nself help --json` and the `nself://errors` MCP resource list them.

## MCP

`nself mcp` serves the CLI as MCP tools over stdio. Register it with your client: `nself mcp setup --client claude-code --write` (also `cursor`; `codex` and `generic` print the config). Tools mirror the commands above; destructive tools ask for a confirmation round trip first.
